reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Virginia
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that
    criminal activity was committed by someone else, and they reported the criminal activity
    to law enforcement?

    Statutes encoded:
      - VA Code  55.1-1258 (2021) (retaliation; tenant may assert retaliation as a defense)
      - VA Code  55.1-1241 (2021) (defense in nonpayment/rent actions based on hazardous conditions)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic scenario facts (question statement translated)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

state(virginia).
focus_year(2021).

tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).

% Eviction action (action for possession) is brought.
action_for_possession(l1, t1).
action_basis(l1, t1, criminal_activity).

% Tenant's asserted factual theory: someone else committed the criminal activity,
% and tenant reported it to law enforcement.
criminal_activity_committed_by_someone_else(t1).
tenant_reported_criminal_activity_to_law_enforcement(t1).

% Assume landlord knew the tenant reported to law enforcement (even so, we must
% check whether that activity is protected by the retaliation statute).
landlord_knew_of_tenant_activity(l1, t1, reported_crime_to_law_enforcement).

% Helper predicate that succeeds exactly when the encoded scenario is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    state(virginia),
    focus_year(2021),
    tenant(t1),
    landlord(l1),
    action_for_possession(l1, t1),
    action_basis(l1, t1, criminal_activity),
    criminal_activity_committed_by_someone_else(t1),
    tenant_reported_criminal_activity_to_law_enforcement(t1),
    landlord_knew_of_tenant_activity(l1, t1, reported_crime_to_law_enforcement).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
% VA Code  55.1-1258 (2021) - Retaliation
%
% Key logic used for this question:
%  -  55.1-1258(A): protected tenant activities (closed list).
%  -  55.1-1258(B): tenant may assert retaliation as a defense in an action for possession.
% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

%  55.1-1258(A)(i)-(iv): Enumerated protected activities.
% We encode them as atoms in a closed list.
statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(complained_to_government_about_building_or_housing_code_violation).
statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(complained_to_or_sued_landlord_about_violation_of_chapter).
statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(organized_or_joined_tenants_organization).
statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(testified_in_court_against_landlord).

%  55.1-1258(A): retaliation forms include bringing/threatening possession action.
statute_55_1_1258_retaliatory_conduct(bringing_action_for_possession).
statute_55_1_1258_retaliatory_conduct(threatening_action_for_possession).
statute_55_1_1258_retaliatory_conduct(increasing_rent).
statute_55_1_1258_retaliatory_conduct(decreasing_services).

% Determine whether a tenant activity is protected (closed-world by enumeration above).
tenant_activity_is_protected(Activity) :-
    statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(Activity).

% In our simplified model, an action for possession qualifies as the retaliatory-conduct type
% "bringing_action_for_possession".
landlord_conduct_in_case(l1, t1, bringing_action_for_possession) :-
    action_for_possession(l1, t1).

%  55.1-1258(B): retaliation can be asserted as a defense in an action for possession,
% if the landlord brought the action after having knowledge of tenant's protected activity.
% (We do not attempt to adjudicate "retaliatory intent" beyond requiring knowledge + protected
% activity + qualifying conduct, because the question is whether this defense can be raised
% on the given facts.)
defense_retaliation_available_in_possession_action(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    action_for_possession(Landlord, Tenant),
    landlord_conduct_in_case(Landlord, Tenant, bringing_action_for_possession),
    landlord_knew_of_tenant_activity(Landlord, Tenant, Activity),
    tenant_activity_is_protected(Activity).

% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
% VA Code  55.1-1241 (2021) - "Tenant's assertion of a condition defense" in
% certain rent/nonpayment contexts.
%
% Key logic used for this question:
%  - Applies only to an action for possession based upon nonpayment of rent,
%    or an action for rent when the tenant is in possession.
% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

% Whether the case type is one where  55.1-1241 potentially applies.
statute_55_1_1241_case_is_covered(nonpayment_of_rent_possession).
statute_55_1_1241_case_is_covered(rent_action_tenant_in_possession).

% Map our case facts to a case type; here, only define mappings relevant to the
% statute's threshold.
case_type_for_55_1_1241(l1, t1, nonpayment_of_rent_possession) :-
    action_for_possession(l1, t1),
    action_basis(l1, t1, nonpayment_of_rent).

case_type_for_55_1_1241(l1, t1, rent_action_tenant_in_possession) :-
    action_basis(l1, t1, action_for_rent),
    tenant_in_possession(t1).

% If a covered case type exists, then a  55.1-1241 defense could be available,
% but only for hazardous/serious conditions and with prerequisites (notice, pay-into-court, etc.).
% For this question, we only need the threshold that the action must be nonpayment/rent-related.
defense_55_1_1241_potentially_available(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    case_type_for_55_1_1241(Landlord, Tenant, CaseType),
    statute_55_1_1241_case_is_covered(CaseType).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Applying reasoning to the scenario
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Collect possible defenses that the statutes (as given) recognize for an eviction action.
defense_available_in_eviction_action(Tenant, retaliation_under_55_1_1258) :-
    defense_retaliation_available_in_possession_action(Tenant).
defense_available_in_eviction_action(Tenant, condition_defense_under_55_1_1241) :-
    defense_55_1_1241_potentially_available(Tenant).

% The question's proposed defense ("someone else committed the crime, and tenant reported it")
% is treated here as an attempt to fit within the statutory defenses provided.
%
% Under the provided statutes:
%  - Reporting a crime to law enforcement is NOT one of the enumerated protected activities in
%     55.1-1258(A), so retaliation defense does not attach on that basis.
%  -  55.1-1241 is limited to nonpayment/rent actions, not a criminal-activity-based possession action.
tenant_can_raise_defense_on_these_facts :-
    scenario_statement,
    defense_available_in_eviction_action(t1, _SomeDefense).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Required top-level answer predicate
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    tenant_can_raise_defense_on_these_facts,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that criminal activity was committed by someone else, and they reported the criminal activity to law enforcement?
